text: Dont-Stop 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 客户端的持续工作监督插件。它通过 /dont-stop 命令为 agent 设置时长或具体时刻的截止时间，并在 agent 提前结束一轮时安排后续轮次，推动其检查遗留工作并继续推进。插件还提供按错误类别等待后自动恢复、提问等待限时、截止时收尾和可选的系统保持唤醒；可用 dont_stop_wait 工具声明正在等待外部事项。设置页可调整恢复、停止、提示间隔、提问时限和唤醒模式。适合希望长时间运行 DSH 工作流并减少任务中断的用户；不需要额外账号或 API 密钥。

Dont-Stop supervises DSH work until a deadline. Use /dont-stop with a duration or clock time; it nudges the agent to continue after a turn and can recover from eligible errors. It limits question waits and can keep the host awake during supervision. No separate account or API key is required.
想给 DSH 里的 agent 设个时间，让它提前做完后自己继续推进。
有没有办法让长时间运行的 DSH 任务到点才结束？
网络或模型服务报错后，希望 agent 等一会儿能自动接着工作。
DSH 的 agent 总卡在等我回答问题，能不能超时后自行决定？
Keep a long-running DSH task moving after the agent finishes a round early.
Can failed DSH work resume automatically after a network or provider error?
Dont-Stop 的功能「按截止时间持续监督」：使用 /dont-stop 加时长或目标时刻启动监督，agent 每轮结束后会按计划续推，直到期限到达；命令也可附带初始任务指令。
Dont-Stop 的功能「错误后自动恢复」：顶层 agent 遇到可分类恢复的回合错误后，插件按错误类别等待并安排恢复；用户可在恢复等待时立即重试或取消。
Dont-Stop 的功能「提问等待限时」：在监督期间，或启用始终限时设置时，等待用户回答的问题到达时限后会关闭等待并提示 agent 自行决定，避免工作停在提问环节。
Dont-Stop 的功能「监督期间保持唤醒」：启用相应设置后，插件根据宿主和操作系统使用可用的保持唤醒方式，并在监督结束时释放保持状态。
Dont-Stop 使用前须知：插件设置保存在 DSH_HOME 指向的目录下；未设置时写入用户目录中的 .dsh/storages/dont-stop/settings.json。
想让 DSH 在长任务里遇到短暂故障后自动等候重试。
Limit how long an agent waits for my answer, then let it choose a next step.

**"我去睡觉了，你自己往后推进工作。"**

> Dont-Stop 插件用于保证智能体长时间持续工作：设定一个截止时间，若 AI 提前完成任务，插件将自动督促智能体继续迭代，自主推进下一步任务。

- 想要 AI 自己迭代推进工作，却经常发现其只工作了一小会就停下了？
- 布置任务后离开，回来发现 AI 只抛了两个问题，实际什么也没干？
- 或是因为临时的网络波动、模型提供商问题导致 AI 工作中断？
- **>>> 启用 Dont-Stop 插件，让 AI 根·本·停·不·下·来！<<<**

```text
/dont-stop 6h 读一下当前目录下的README和相关文档，把相关功能全部落地实现。
```

dsh-dont-stop README · 安装：- **在插件市场里装**：在 DSH 的插件市场（`dsh-market`）里搜 `Dont-Stop` 或 `dsh-dont-stop`，点一下装好（dsh 0.2.1 起市场就在「插件」页里，更早的宿主从 设置 → 插件市场 进入）。目录页：[awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/TCY07/dsh-dont-stop](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/TCY07/dsh-dont-stop/)
- **在 DSH 里装**：打开侧边栏的「插件」页 → 添加插件，填 `dsh-dont-stop`。同一个入口也接受 `github:TCY07/dsh-dont-stop`（或 `https://github.com/TCY07/dsh-dont-stop`）和本地绝对目录路径。
- **命令行**：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-dont-stop`
- **卸载**：在插件页移除，或 `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-dont-stop`

dsh-dont-stop README · 快速上手：| 命令 | 效果 |
| --- | --- |
| `/dont-stop 6h` | 干到 6 小时后；不带时长默认 6 小时 |
| `/dont-stop 6h 把文档补完再跑一遍测试` | 命令后接具体指令：将作为一条用户消息发送 |
| `/dont-stop until 22:00` | 干到下一个 22:00（今天已过则顺延到明天） |
| `/dont-stop 6h --no-stop` | 使用 `--no-stop` 临时覆盖插件设置，到点后不强制停止（`--stop` 相反） |
| `/dont-stop off` | 提前收工 |

dsh-dont-stop README · 快速上手：- **支持各种时间写法**：`6h`、`6 hour`、`6 小时`、`90m`、`8min`、`8分钟`、`1.5h`、`2天`、`3 天`、`1.5天`、`2day`、`2 days`、`2日`。数字与单位之间可以有空格，但**多段时长要写在一起**：`1h30m`、`1小时30分钟` 可正确解析为 90 分钟；写成 `1h 30m` 会被解析为 1 小时，`30m` 会被当成用户指令。`until` 接受 `22:00`、`22：00`（中文冒号）、`22点`、`22点30分`、`22时`、`22時30`。

- `--stop` / `--no-stop` 参数可附加在其他指令后面（用户指令之前），将临时覆盖插件设置页的「到点停止」选项，只作用于当前这一轮 Dont-Stop 生命周期。

dsh-dont-stop README · 兼容性：当前开发版本为 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5（Web / Desktop）。

保持唤醒按 DSH 类型与系统自动选择方式，不修改系统电源设置：

| DSH / 系统 | 手段 |
| --- | --- |
| 桌面版（Electron，Windows / macOS / Linux） | 进程内电源请求（`powerSaveBlocker`） |
| Web / CLI（Windows） | PowerShell 调用 `SetThreadExecutionState` |
| Web / CLI（macOS） | `caffeinate -i`，并监视宿主进程 |
| Web / CLI（Linux） | `systemd-inhibit` 持锁 |
| WSL / 容器 | 不生效，只提示去宿主机设置 |

以下情况插件无法阻止，只能靠系统设置：合盖睡眠、手动睡眠/休眠、电量临界时强制休眠、断电或蓝屏。

dsh-dont-stop README · 功能：- **持续工作**：给 agent 设定一个截止时间，它提前完成任务也会被督促继续迭代，一直工作到时间到。
- **自主推进**：督促 agent 自己检查遗留问题、制定下一步目标，必要时扩大范围或升级目标——而不只是简单的“继续”。
- **错误自动恢复**：碰到限流、额度不足、请求超时、服务端错误、网络中断时，等待一段时间后自动重试；（在 DSH 内置的重试框架外又套了一层：单次最多等 90 分钟，连续同类失败可累计数小时）
- **定时停止**：当截止时间到达时，要求 agent 迅速收尾，并在一段缓冲时间后强停。
- **提问限时**：agent 提问后长时间等不到回答，则自动关闭提问并自行决定，避免卡在等待用户回答的状态。
- **保持系统唤醒**：Dont-Stop 启用期间阻止系统睡眠（可选）。

dsh-dont-stop README · 设置：在 DSH 设置页的 Dont-Stop 一项里调整，改完立即生效，不影响正在进行的这一轮监督。

| 设置 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 错误恢复 | 开 | 遇到限流、额度不足、网络、服务商错误时自动重试；打开后在非 Dont-Stop 状态下也生效 |
| 到点停止 | 开 | 到点叫醒 agent 收尾，并停掉残留的 subagent 与后台任务；关闭后到点不强行停止 |
| 提示间隔 | 0 秒（不限） | 两条督促消息之间的最短间隔 |
| 始终开启提问限时 | 关 | Dont-Stop 未启用时也限制提问的等待时长 |
| 提问限时 | 300 秒 | 等用户回答的上限时间，超时后关闭提问并要求 agent 自行决定；0 表示不限 |
| 保持系统唤醒 | 插电时 | Dont-Stop 启用期间阻止系统睡眠；可选关闭 / 插电时 / 始终 |

dsh-dont-stop README · Install：- **From the plugin market**: search for `Dont-Stop` or `dsh-dont-stop` in the DSH plugin market (`dsh-market`) and install it in one click (from dsh 0.2.1 the market sits on the Plugins page; older hosts open it from Settings → Plugin market). Catalog page: [awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/TCY07/dsh-dont-stop](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/TCY07/dsh-dont-stop/)
- **In DSH**: open the **Plugins** page in the sidebar and choose Add plugin, then enter `dsh-dont-stop`. The same dialog also accepts `github:TCY07/dsh-dont-stop` (or `https://github.com/TCY07/dsh-dont-stop`) and an absolute local directory path.
- **CLI**: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-dont-stop`
- **Uninstall**: remove it on the plugin page, or `dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-dont-stop`

dsh-dont-stop README · Quick start：| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `/dont-stop 6h` | Work for six hours; without a duration it means six hours |
| `/dont-stop 6h finish the docs and rerun the tests` | Text after the command is sent as a user message |
| `/dont-stop until 22:00` | Work until the next 22:00 (rolls over to tomorrow if it has already passed) |
| `/dont-stop 6h --no-stop` | Temporarily override the plugin setting: no forced stop at the deadline (`--stop` is the opposite) |
| `/dont-stop off` | Stop early |

dsh-dont-stop README · Quick start：- **Durations in many spellings**: `6h`, `6 hour`, `6 小时`, `90m`, `8min`, `8分钟`, `1.5h`, `2天`, `3 天`, `1.5天`, `2day`, `2 days`, `2日`. Spaces between the number and the unit are fine, but **compound durations must be written as one word**: `1h30m` and `1小时30分钟` both mean 90 minutes; `1h 30m` is read as 1 hour and `30m` becomes the user instruction. `until` accepts `22:00`, `22：00` (full-width colon), `22点`, `22点30分`, `22时`, `22時30`.

dsh-dont-stop README · Quick start：- `--stop` / `--no-stop` may follow other text (before the user instruction), override the "stop at the deadline" setting for the current cycle only, and are reset when that cycle ends.

dsh-dont-stop README · Compatibility：Currently built for DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 (Web / Desktop).

The keep-awake mechanism is picked automatically from the host type and the OS, and no system power setting is changed:

dsh-dont-stop README · Compatibility：| Host / OS | Mechanism |
| --- | --- |
| Desktop app (Electron, Windows / macOS / Linux) | in-process power request (`powerSaveBlocker`) |
| Web / CLI (Windows) | PowerShell calling `SetThreadExecutionState` |
| Web / CLI (macOS) | `caffeinate -i`, watching the host process |
| Web / CLI (Linux) | a `systemd-inhibit` lock |
| WSL / containers | not possible; the plugin only tells you to set the host machine instead |

dsh-dont-stop README · Compatibility：These can never be prevented by a plugin, only by a system setting: closing the lid, sleeping or hibernating manually, forced hibernation on critical battery, power loss and blue screens.

dsh-dont-stop README · Features：- **Deadline supervision**: set a deadline; finishing early gets the agent nudged to keep iterating until the time is up.
- **Autonomous progress**: each nudge asks the agent to check what is left, set the next goal itself, and widen or raise the goal when that is the better move — it picks up the next piece of work instead of being sent a bare "continue".
- **Automatic error recovery**: on rate limits, exhausted quota, request timeouts, server errors and network failures it waits a while and then tries again. (This wraps a second wait around DSH's own retry: one wait can be up to 90 minutes, and repeated failures of the same kind can add up to hours.)
- **Stop at the deadline**: when the deadline arrives, the agent is asked to wrap up quickly, and everything is force-stopped after a grace period.
- **Question time limit**: a question that goes unanswered for too long is closed and the agent is asked to decide for itself, so it never sits stuck waiting for a reply.
- **Keep the system awake**: blocks system sleep while Dont-Stop is active (optional).
dsh-dont-stop README · Settings：Everything lives on the Dont-Stop page in the DSH settings, and takes effect immediately without disturbing the current supervision cycle.

dsh-dont-stop README · Settings：| Setting | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Error recovery | on | Retries automatically after rate limits, exhausted quota, network and provider errors; when on, it also applies outside Dont-Stop sessions |
| Stop at the deadline | on | Wakes the agent at the deadline to wrap up and stops the subagents and background jobs left behind; when off, nothing is force-stopped at the deadline |
| Prompt interval | 0 s (no limit) | Shortest gap between two Dont-Stop nudges |
| Always limit question waits | off | Applies the question limit even while Dont-Stop is not active |
| Question wait limit | 300 s | Longest wait for an answer; after that the question is closed and the agent decides on its own; 0 means no limit |
| Keep the system awake | on AC power | Blocks system sleep while Dont-Stop is active; choose off / on AC power / always |
